faq_test_set.ai_answer_rate_proxy: answer_accuracy on curated common-FAQ cases; offline proxy, not production independent-resolution rate

project_runtime.ai_answer_rate_status: not_observable_from_trace_schema; offline test-set answer accuracy is reported separately
project_runtime.maintenance_effort_reduction_status: not_observable; no before/after human-maintenance time records
project_runtime.limitation: Trace hit rate means a trace contained retrieval evidence. Pipeline latency is not buyer-message-to-delivered-reply end-to-end time.

definitions.offline_common_faq_answer_rate: cases whose top retrieved answer contains every required phrase and no forbidden phrase / all test cases
definitions.knowledge_base_hit_rate: runtime traces with non-empty evidence / valid runtime traces
definitions.knowledge_maintenance_effort_reduction: (pre-AI matched manual minutes - post-AI matched manual minutes) / pre-AI matched manual minutes; unavailable without logged time observations
definitions.average_response_time: mean total_latency_ms over runtime traces; this project field measures internal pipeline latency, not end-to-end delivery
